entries.title: Tell HN: Firefox Is an awesome browser right now
entries.author: rrishi
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Firefox Is an awesome browser right now
entries.excerpt: I was having trouble loading GMail in Chrome. I wasn't sure if it was my spotty internet or the browser acting up so I gave Firefox a shot. And behold! Firefox opened it in a jiffy. What impressed me most was that it was able to import saved passwords, bookmarks and websites history from Chrome pretty quickly. Previously, I had imported these to Chromium based web browsers (Brave & Edge) but was afraid that it might be an issue for non-Chromium browser like Firefox, but to my
entries.guide_zh: 用户分享从 Chrome 转用 Firefox 后加载 Gmail 和迁移资料的顺畅体验。

entries.title: Tell HN: DEI initiatives undermine the self esteem of PoC within a company
entries.author: qzx_pierri
entries.current_title: Tell HN: DEI initiatives undermine the self esteem of PoC within a company
entries.excerpt: As a black man, I have some issues with the DEI (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion) trend. As it exists within some (most?) companies, it seems to perpetuate imposter syndrome significantly. For example, I know I'm talented - I've got the projects, certs, and experience to back it up. entries.guide_zh: 一位黑人从业者认为公司 DEI 活动会加重有色人种员工的冒名顶替感。

entries.title: Ask HN: How do you deal with information and internet addiction?
entries.author: rqtwteye
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do you deal with information and internet addiction?
entries.excerpt: I have noticed that I am getting more and more addicted to consuming information so I am listening to podcasts while working and I watch Youtube videos in my free time. This is all fun and interesting but I feel this makes me want to do things less and less. Instead of working on my own problems I distract myself by listening to ever more information. I get a lot of benefit from this information but somehow it feels shallow. I think part of it is that my work is quite uninter
entries.guide_zh: 信息消费越来越难停下来，如何应对播客、网页等带来的网络成瘾？

entries.title: Ask HN: Why Did Medium.com “fail"?
entries.author: slymerson

entries.guide_zh: Medium 仍在运营，为何却给人“失败”的感觉，讨论平台吸引力的变化。

entries.title: Launch HN: Lago (YC S21) – Open-source usage-based billing
entries.author: Rafsark
entries.current_title: Launch HN: Lago (YC S21) – Open-source usage-based billing
entries.excerpt: Hi HN, we’re the cofounders of Lago: an open-source alternative to Stripe Billing, Chargebee, and Recurly. That is, we make software that helps businesses calculate how much their own customers should pay them—based on their subscription, consumption, discounts, taxes, credit notes, or negotiated terms—and then invoice them. entries.guide_zh: Lago 介绍开源计费软件，按订阅、用量、折扣等规则计算账单并生成发票。
